claims.claim_atom: The geometric mean of (melanopic) light exposure is the most sensitive metric to seasonal change: it reaches the 80% power threshold at the smallest tested sample size (n=3), where power is already 100%.
claims._stochastic: 功效以每档 10 次 bootstrap 重采样计算,分辨率 0.1;Geometric mean 在 n=3 即 power=1.0,远高于阈值,是稳健的最敏感指标。换种子重跑仍应在 n=3 达标 → 判 consistent,勿因随机小抖动误判(FP陷阱)。
_reproduction: Docker R (r-base 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1) 跑 PowerCalc.qmd 的 results-table 逻辑于论文 shipped Power_data.csv: Geometric mean 最小达标样本量=3, 该处 power=1.0

claims.claim_atom: Of the 12 light-exposure metrics, 11 reach 80% power within the tested sample-size range (n<=50); the single exception, Midpoint of darkest 5 hours (L5), never reaches the threshold (its power peaks at 0.6).
claims._stochastic: 汇总表 11 行 = 11 个达标指标;missing 集恰为 1 个 (L5 midpoint),其 power 全程 <=0.6。grounding:须区分 required-sample-size 表(达标指标)与 missing 脚注(未达标),别把两者混算。
_reproduction: Power_summary_reproduced.csv 有 11 行; base::setdiff 得 missing = {'Midpoint of darkest 5 hours (L5, hh:mm)'}; 该指标在 Power_data.csv 各样本量 power 最大 0.6

claims.claim_atom: Timing metrics require substantially larger samples than intensity metrics: Mean timing of light above 250 lx needs n=21 to reach 80% power, versus n=3 for the geometric mean.
claims._note: consistent: 21 (timing>250lx) > 3 (geomean),达标样本量差 7 倍,支持论文'timing 指标更难检出季节差异'的结论。

claims.claim_atom: The per-metric required sample sizes are stable population estimates that would generalize beyond this 13-participant shift-worker cohort.
claims._note: insufficient: code output 仅给出基于 n=13 参与者、每档 10 次 bootstrap(功效分辨率 0.1)的样本内点估计。是否可外推到其他人群、以及点估计的稳定性,无法仅凭该 Power_data.csv 判定。论文本身亦定位为该数据集的探索性功效分析,未做此强断言,故不判 inconsistent,而判证据不足。
